newsitem.title: CHILE: Duff & Phelps ups Chilquinta Int'l rating.
newsitem.headline: Duff & Phelps ups Chilquinta Int'l rating.

text.p: Duff & Phelps Credit Rating Co said it has upgraded the securities of Chilquinta International A.V.V to A-minus from BBB-plus, based on an unconditional guarantee from holding company Chilquinta SA.

"The upgrade reflects Chilquinta's improving financial profile, generally constructive regulatory environment, low business risk and its economically healthy and growing service territory," said Duff & Phelps in a statement.
Chilquinta International is a special purpose company formed in Aruba to hold 44 percent of Ontario-Quinta A.V.V., a joint venture between Chilquinta and Canada's Ontario Hydro.
The joint venture owns 60 percent of Luz del Sur, an electricity distribution company in Lima.
International is almost wholly owned by Chilquinta, Chile's third largest power distributor.
